title: upstream-import keeps only the first line of a fenced multi-line premise in its Premise: notes line
goal: an imported draft's Premise: notes line holds the whole premise of a fenced multi-line block from the issue body (joined or quoted), so upstream-report reads back the same premise it wrote

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_upstream,inspect;sys.exit(1 if 'Premise' in inspect.getsource(bl_upstream) else 0)

repro_reason: the import runs on a saved issue body in a throwaway clone; the worker reported the first-line limit (ST-2d26ca6z), and the repro marks the code path until a planted round-trip check replaces it
